Question 3(a) [4 marks]: Describe ONE transformed and ONE transforming resource that would be used in the operations process at Small Wall Motors.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Small Wall Motors are about to introduce a new vehicle into their range. They aim to have the vehicle on the market within twelve months.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Describes ONE transforming and ONE transformed resource and relates relevant examples of how they are used in Small Wall Motors' operations process
2–3 marks: Identifies ONE transforming resource and/or ONE transformed resource and/or provides a relevant example of how it is used at Small Wall Motors
1 marks: Identifies ONE transforming or transformed resource


ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Transformed resources are inputs that are changed or converted in the operations process: materials (raw materials and intermediate goods such as steel and components), information (knowledge, external or internal KPIs) and customers. Transforming resources remain in the business and are applied to the inputs to change them and add value: human resources (the skilled workforce) and facilities (land, buildings, equipment, technology such as the assembly line).
